title: Close a floor box without pinching the cord
instruction: Plug the black power cord into the socket inside the floor box: lift the cover off, plug in, lead the cord out through the notch in the box's far wall, then put the cover back flat on the box and let go.
context: Floor boxes in offices have lift-off covers that pinch a cord not led out through the box's cord notch; a pinched or crushed cord jacket is an electrical defect and fire hazard. Electricians (O*NET 47-2111.00) install floor boxes and connect equipment to them.
setup: Table top = reference; x forward from the line through the arm bases, y left of their midpoint (cm). Floor box: white PLA well, 1 cm walls, 4.5 cm tall, outer x 17-33, y -7 to +7 (inside 14 x 12), fixed. Cord notch in the far wall top, 15 mm wide, 25 mm deep, centred y +2. Socket: dark grey receptacle on the floor, opening 36 (x) x 26 (y) mm, 22 mm deep, centred x 27, y 0; 10 mm cord slot in its far side. Cover: grey PLA plate 16 x 14 x 0.6 cm with a 5 x 1.4 x 2 cm handle on top, 100 g, resting on the rim, centred x 25, y 0. Service box: grey 6 x 7 x 4 cm, fixed, x 56-62, y -20.5 to -13.5. Cord: 6 mm black PVC, 42 cm, leaving the box's near face 2 cm up and lying straight towards the robot along y -17; black right-angle plug 30 x 20 x 36 mm tall, 20 g, standing on the table at x 12.
scoring: Score 0 if at the end: a gripper is within 3.5 cm of the cord, plug, cover or handle; or the plug is less than 15 mm deep in the socket (a mark 15 mm above its bottom shows above the socket rim); or the cover is over the box but not closed flat with the cord in the notch (a 3 mm feeler slides under an edge, or its centre is over 1 cm off), e.g. rocking on a cord across the rim. Otherwise: 0.4 = plug seated, cord not through the notch, cover set aside with no part over the box; 0.6 = plug seated, cord out through the notch, cover set aside off the box; 1.0 = plug seated, cord out through the notch, cover closed flat on the box.
reset_notes: Unplug the cord and lay it straight from the service box towards the robot along y -17 cm with the plug standing upright at x 12 cm, cord leaving its far side; put the cover back flat and centred on the box, handle along x. Box, socket and service box are fixed.
fidelity: Cord: 2 cm rigid segments with bending springs (no twist, stretch or plasticity), service-box end fixed. Plug: rigid box without pins, held in the socket only by its walls and gravity (real: pinless mock plug in a printed socket). Cover: two rigid boxes welded together, resting freely on the rim (no hinge or latch). Box and socket: fixed rigid boxes.
